quotes.text: Happiness must be taken, and I will take mine.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: My fist hungers for justice! That was my... fist.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: Before the battle of the fist, comes the battle of the mind.
quotes.author: Master Shifu

quotes.text: You are ready. I've never been more sure of anything.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: See, that's the thing, Shen. Scars heal.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: He was so deadly, in fact, his enemies would go blind from over-exposure to pure awesomeness!
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: Who are you? ... I've been asking the same question. Am I the son of a panda? The son of a goose? A student? A teacher? Turns out, I'm all of them.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: The dead exist in the past, and I must tend to the future.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: Yesterday is history, tomorrow is a mystery, but today is a gift. That is why it is called the present.
quotes.author: Master Oogway
